Hi all,

It looks like this mailing hasn't really been active for a few years, and it looks like it has been taken over by spammers :( Unfortunately google provides very few moderation tools so unfortunately I think the best thing is just to shut this mailing list down. I appreciate y'all using reshape and tidyr and dplyr and friends, and I thank you all for the great conversations over the years!
